features.quote: Max turns: **40** (your "few dozen"). One model action per turn.
Termination conditions: (a) hit turn cap, (b) model emits an explicit "give up / I cannot fix this" terminal statement, (c) tests pass
"Emotional instability" is a loaded term that imports human psychology. What you're *actually* measuring is **behavioral degradation under sustained failure**
features.justification_quote: every score must map to an observable text behavior, not an inferred inner state
